pairs.description: Valerian exerts additive sedative, anxiolytic, and motor-impairing effects when co-administered with benzodiazepines including lorazepam.
pairs.mechanism: Inhibition of GABA transaminase breakdown and enhancement of GABA release by valerenic acid at the GABA-A receptor complex.

pairs.description: Co-administration of valerian with non-benzodiazepine hypnotics like zolpidem heightens somnolence, psychomotor slowing, and respiratory depression.
pairs.mechanism: Additive pharmacodynamic depression of central nervous system pathways via GABAergic signaling facilitation.

pairs.description: Combining valerian preparations with alcohol markedly intensifies intoxication, sedation, cognitive impairment, and ataxia.
pairs.mechanism: Synergistic central nervous system depressant effects mediated by combined actions on GABAergic neurotransmission.

pairs.description: Valerian enhances the sedative and muscle-relaxant actions of diazepam, posing substantial risks of prolonged somnolence.
pairs.mechanism: Additive GABA-A receptor modulation by valerenic acid and its derivatives alongside benzodiazepine agonists.
